attributes.law_screen: Current laws roster, NMWException brief, exception destructor context and sdata residual law screen read. claim.law.inline-and-deadstrip-rules.20260829.v1 motivates existing-method emission tests; claim.law.PC_storage-class-of-a-same-tu-base-object-is-a-codegen-lever-that-must-be-gated-tu-wide.20260902.v1 and claim.law.SL_pool-constant-errors-are-score-invisible.20260901.v1 require complete sections/relocations, not function scores. claim.R67_runtime-rewrites-are-isolated-from-editable-builds.20260905.v1 explicitly leaves necessity hypothetical. No prior function source-form cap applies to these runtime header/home controls. No new postprocessor mode or source-unreachability law is asserted.
measurements: Reproducer tools/gdl/composed_census/r73_runtime_source_probe.py --out build/r73_runtime_source_result.json completes. Actual-source and explicit-header controls reproduce both complete raw objects byte-for-byte. No production source, config, raw object or linked image is changed.

Late handler definitions preserve all NMW function bodies and leave .sdata handlers at0/4 and RTTI at8. Reversing the handlers exchanges their named homes while RTTI stays8. Inline-what plus late handlers also leaves RTTI8. Thus simply moving those declarations below the members does not implement the required RTTI-first allocation.

Inline exception::what preserves existing ExceptionPPC bodies and adds an out-of-line weak what method; emitted .rodata grows134->146 bytes and contains the previously appended exception literal. It also creates additional weak/vtable home obligations. NMW inline-what moves what from its original early strong home to a trailing weak home and .rodata27->26. A homogeneous inline header removes both NMW exception members and RTTI. A homogeneous declaration header removes the duplicate ExceptionPPC base destructor but changes bad_exception's destructor body. None is a drop-in source replacement.

Actual full-image link control reproduces current ELF byte-for-byte and DOL byte-for-byte. Substituting only raw ExceptionPPC gives1533 differing DOL file bytes; inline-what variant gives991; declaration-only gives153748. Every trial links, has2351264-byte DOL and preserves all other ordered link inputs. File-byte totals are diagnostics, not function fuzzy scores or semantic improvement; no candidate retained.

An initial sibling-header-only overlay was found not to override the configured include path; its variant results were discarded. The shipped reproducer uses an explicit include path and byte-identical unchanged overlay plus a compiler-error sentinel. This prevents an inert header experiment from being mistaken for a compiler invariant.
attributes.probed_form: NMW independent placement: move `static terminate_handler thandler = dthandler; static unexpected_handler uhandler = duhandler;` from before `exception::~exception` to after `exception::what`; reverse those two definitions as an order-sensitive control. Header axis: replace `virtual const char* what() const;` by `virtual const char* what() const { return "exception"; }`, removing the duplicate out-of-line NMW member; test jointly with late handlers. Homogeneous inline control replaces the NMWEXCEPTION_CPP destructor declaration/definition split with `virtual ~exception() throw() {}` and removes the out-of-line NMW destructor. Homogeneous declaration control uses `virtual ~exception() throw();` for both TUs. Explicit unchanged overlay plus `#error R73_HEADER_OVERLAY_ACTIVE` controls verify the edited header actually reaches MWCC.
attributes.remaining: Runtime postprocessing remains unchanged. The narrow mechanisms are RTTI home emission relative to initialized handler storage, duplicate weak base-destructor retention/EH relationships, and rodata ownership/alignment. The four-byte NMW prefix described by the existing fixer as belonging to a preceding unit remains an ownership question. Do not infer universal compiler necessity from these finite source controls.
